title: A Parish for the Autopsy
author: Ivo Marchetti
blurb: Paloma Kavanagh, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the trial begins.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
